p4.title: The four seasons
p4.text: In many parts of the world, there are __(1)__ seasons: spring, summer, autumn and winter. Each __(2)__ is different. In spring, the flowers start __(3)__ and the weather is __(4)__. In summer, the sun __(5)__ very bright and many children go __(6)__ holiday. In autumn, the leaves turn red, yellow and brown, and __(7)__ start to wear jackets. In winter, some places __(8)__ lots of snow and it is __(9)__ cold. Near the equator, there __(10)__ only two seasons – a dry and a rainy one.

parts.text: Last January, there was a big surprise in my town. When I woke up on Tuesday morning, I looked out of the window and I couldn’t believe my eyes. There was snow everywhere! It was the first snow in our town for six years. I quickly put on my coat, scarf and gloves and I ran outside. My neighbour Joe was already there with his little dog, Bertie. We decided to build a snowman together. Our snowman was 1 metre 20 tall. We gave him two round black stones for eyes, a carrot for his nose, and Joe’s old red hat. We called him Mr Chilly. Then my sister Kate came outside. She had a big plastic plate and we used it to slide down the small hill near our house. At lunchtime, Mum called us for hot chocolate. By the afternoon, the snow started to melt, but Mr Chilly stayed until the next morning.

p6.title: Winter in the mountains
p6.text: Every December, __(0)__ go to the mountains with my parents. We love skiing and playing in the snow. Our house there is small but __(1)__ is very warm inside. We always __(2)__ lots of warm clothes: coats, hats, scarves and boots. In the morning, we go skiing. In the afternoon, we __(3)__ hot chocolate in a café. I’m not __(4)__ good skier as my brother, but I try hard. Once, my brother fell __(5)__ his skis – it was very funny! In the evening, we watch films and play cards by the fire.
